prompts.prompt:

Prepare a production parallax layer for the SAME image. OUTPUT CANVAS MUST BE 1024 pixels wide by 1536 pixels high, portrait 2:3, exactly the original full canvas. Never crop to content, never center isolated objects, never scale, rotate, translate, reframe or change the camera. Preserve all retained objects' exact original size, orientation, pose, position, contours, faceted painted texture, lighting and colors. Do not redesign or reinterpret any object. Output ONE layer only, no contact sheet, no border, no labels, no text.

Layer: 01 BACKGROUND / courtyard clean plate, completely opaque.
Remove the entire cat including its tail, every paw, all fur and whiskers. Remove the whole green trading table and its wooden front, all coins, BOTH human hands and sleeves, all held cards and the falling red calamity card, and its motion streaks. Retain the original background courtyard architecture in EXACT registration: dark arched recess at upper left, amber hanging lantern, gold-orange stucco walls and columns, bougainvillea across the upper middle, blue sky and the distant bell tower at upper right. Reconstruct the architecture and courtyard ground hidden behind the cat and table, seamlessly continuing the existing columns down to a simple warm terracotta paved courtyard floor. Preserve the existing visible upper background exactly; only invent the hidden area. Rich golden afternoon lighting, the same angular low-poly painted style. Keep the lower courtyard quiet and simple as it will be mostly hidden. Opaque artwork must fill the entire 1024x1536 frame, no transparency and no missing areas. No remaining fragments or shadows of the removed cat/table/hands/cards. This plate will sit behind the original scene.

iterations.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / transparent foreground layer repair.
INPUT ROLES:
Image 1 is the foreground CUTOUT TO EDIT.
Image 2 is the ORIGINAL COMPLETE ARTWORK and authoritative geometry reference for the cat's actual foreleg shape.
Image 3 is the CENTER LAYER that the cutout must sit over.
Image 4 is an overlay proof showing the FAULT: the foreleg has a rounded fluffy stump/cap pasted over the cat's white chest.
Task: Repair ONLY the upper attachment and upper silhouette of the diagonal reaching foreleg in image 1. Everything else in image 1 must stay unchanged, in exactly the same position: white paw and toes, falling red tower card, gold motion strokes, left human hand and sleeve, right hand/green cards/navy sleeve. Never shift or rescale the cutout.
The resulting foreground must fit over image 3 and match image 2's natural foreleg-to-body join. In image 2, the reaching leg emerges from BELOW AND BEHIND the LEFT EDGE of the white chest ruff. It is NOT a detached furry sausage with a rounded top. Delete the invented round orange cap and the invented orange/brown region that overlaps the white chest (roughly x550–680,y455–650). That region must become fully TRANSPARENT so image 3's original white ruff shows on top. Replace the overly broad upper arm shape with the exact slimmer slanting orange-brown foreleg shape from image 2: the upper leg follows the cat's LEFT shoulder, with its right edge hugging the left contour of the white ruff, then running diagonally down-left to the unchanged white paw. Keep only a modest dark orange-brown overlap at the true shoulder, to the LEFT of the white chest, not a visible end cap. Copy the fur color and angular planes from image 2 at that join so the upper leg transitions into image 3's shoulder. No white chest or head included in foreground.
Return the corrected FOREGROUND CUTOUT ONLY. Full canvas must remain 1024x1536. Genuine alpha transparency outside the isolated foreground objects. DO NOT return the combined scene or include any cat face, torso, tail, chest ruff, table, coins, courtyard or background. Do not redraw the white paw, card, human hands or motion lines. No matte background, no decorative glow, no halo. Do not crop or recenter. All unchanged pixels must keep their source registration.

validation: Local alpha inspection and exact source-over render of saved layer PNGs at neutral and small opposing offsets. Layer image files were not modified by the QA renderer.
